title: Algebraic Transfer for Operator-Valued Gaussian Chaoses:Oriented Schatten Profiles and Singular Wick Multipliers
summary: We develop an algebraic transfer calculus for the oriented Schatten profiles of kernels underlying operator-valued Gaussian chaoses. A dimension-free link inequality propagates profile bounds through cut factorizations, tensor products, coefficient maps, and ordered contractions. Besides the constant-one strong Schatten theorem, we prove the sharp weak endpoint \[ \mathfrak{S}_{r,\infty}\times\mathfrak{S}_{r,\infty} \longrightarrow \mathfrak{S}_{r,\infty}(\log\mathfrak{S})^{-1/r}, \qquad 1<r<\infty. \] The estimate holds uniformly over all contracted Hilbert spaces, and the exponent $1/r$…
